title: Say Baleg a Panagpasakop na Soberano
intro: Naromog mo so inkasika ed sakey a dalin na kadaanan iran pakelaw tan aralem a panangiparungtal. Sakey a makapanyarin manuley, ya akaarap ed ag-iilaloan ya imbitasyon, so ginmapo ed sakey a biahe ya manguman ed kurso na kapalaran to tan say pananisia na totoo to. Naamtaan mo kasi so pakabidbiran na sayan makapadinayew a too?
clues: Nanoleyan ak ed sakey a maaligwas a nanarian, a naarkosan na baleg a kayamanan tan sakey a makapadinayew a trono.
Siak tan saray totook et nandayew ed sakey a laman ed tawen, ya manisia kamin satan so katawan mi, anggaman wala ray panduaruwak ed pusok.
Sakey a nikadkaduman mensahero, sakey a manok, so angiter na sulat ed siak, ya ontatawag ed siak tan saray totook ya manpasakop ed Sakey a Dios.
Kinonsulta ko ray managkonseho ko, ya mabiskeg so biskeg da, no panon kon ebatan iyan agnaparaan ya mensahe.
Nandesisyon ak ya mangipawit na mablin regalo ed samay angibaki na sulat, diad paniilalo kon nasukat so pakayari tan getma to.
Nen sinmabi ak, abigla ak ed sakey a palasyo ya say datal to et gawad salming, ya singa sakey a lawak na danum, tan diman ko indeklara so panagpasakop ko ed Katawan na amin a pinalsa.

options: Say biahe pian napinengnengan si Propeta Sulayman
Say inkaderal na saray totoo nen Lut
Say impamool ed si Propeta Ibrahim
trial.answer: Say biahe pian napinengnengan si Propeta Sulayman

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Indaulo to ray totoo to ed bakal

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
verse: Indeed, I found a woman ruling them and she has been given of every thing and for her (is) a throne great (23) (27:23)
